description: Canonical machine-readable external-action authority state for every scheduled external-action surface. Read by ~/workspace/outreach/authority-check.py before ANY external action (likes, comments, follows, DMs, emails, form submits). OWNER/OPERATOR WRITE ONLY: no scheduled worker, cron body, or agent run may write this file; only a new explicit owner decision changes a status. A schedule is NOT authorization. A stale note is NOT authorization. A cleared platform timer is NOT authorization.
re_enable_procedure: Only the owner/operator may change a status. The procedure is: (1) owner records the new explicit decision in the platform tripwire review entry where one exists (tiktok-like-recovery.py record-review), (2) owner or operator edits this file's surface status/reason/set_by/set_at, (3) the next scheduled pass runs authority-check.py which re-consumes everything. Workers never write this file and never infer resumption from a cleared banner, timer, or schedule.
